root_cause: The Netlify ignore gate treated site/website-release-risk.json as a runtime artifact even though it only controls CI website release classification, so governance-only changes caused a full production build.
prevention: Treat site/website-release-risk.json as governanceExact in the pre-build ignore gate. Real runtime artifacts such as netlify.toml and assets remain outside the ignore allowlist and still require a production build.

evidence.observed_deploy: Production deploy for #3911 took 126 seconds although the change only adjusted website release-risk classification and CI evidence.
